$comment: Design Gate B grey-box campaign level (tools/maps/make_design_gate_b.py). Attackers try to capture the eastern bluff objective; player must stop them until sunset (3:45) or rout 700 permille of the attacking force. Lightning is active in hand; Wind Shift remains in pendingPowers until wind power rules land.
title: Crossing at Oakhaven Reach (Gate B)

hand.note: Swell the north river to flood the southern ford and slow cavalry.
Weaken the central wooden bridge under heavy infantry or siege weight.
Strike the bluff-side approach or ignite the dry hedgerow (30 m fixed radius).

pendingPowers.note: Pending wind power rules: shift crosswind plume over the ford/bluff.

sideQuests.description: Rot or overload the central wooden bridge before the infantry clears it.
Keep enemy soldiers off the eastern bluff for the entire defense.
